gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all status categories in Jira to better understand the workflow states available for my projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all status categories, including their IDs and names, allowing me to categorize issues effectively.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to fetch details of a specific status category by its ID or key to ensure I am using the correct category in my issue transitions.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified status category, including its name and description, so I can verify its attributes.
